children.name: firefox
api/auth-api.spec.ts
Auth — API & network layer
login page is reachable and serves HTML
direct POST to login endpoint with bad credentials does not 5xx
Auth — captured network traffic
captures all network requests during a successful login
logout via UI ends the authenticated session locally
credentials shown on the page are accepted by login flow
api/order-api.spec.ts
Order & upload — API & network layer
file-upload endpoint is reachable
direct multipart POST to /file-upload does not 5xx
Order — captured submission traffic
submitting an order issues network calls or a console signal
upload via UI reflects the uploaded filename in the response
e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 A + AA)
login page has no critical a11y violations
shop page (post-login) has no critical a11y violations
checkout shipping form has no critical a11y violations
file upload page has no critical a11y violations
e2e/auth-ecommerce.spec.ts
E-commerce auth + order — happy path
logs in, adds 2 products, completes checkout, and logs out
credentials displayed on the page match what we use
e2e/auth-edge-cases.spec.ts
E-commerce — auth edge cases
rejects invalid password — shows Bad credentials error
rejects unknown email — shows Bad credentials error
empty form submit shows Bad credentials error
email-only submit (empty password) shows Bad credentials error
removing a cart item updates the total
logout clears authenticated state — re-navigation lands on login form
e2e/cart-edge-cases.spec.ts
Cart — edge cases
clicking ADD TO CART twice for the same product is a no-op on the second click
cart total equals the sum of unit prices for all added products
removing every item one by one returns the cart total to zero
proceeding to checkout with an empty cart still navigates without crashing
e2e/checkout-edge-cases.spec.ts
Checkout — edge cases
changing the country select updates the bound option
special characters in shipping fields are accepted as plain text
phone field accepts numeric input but does not coerce non-numeric to empty
clicking Submit Order without a phone number still attempts submission
e2e/file-upload-edge-cases.spec.ts
File upload — edge cases
uploads a file with a very long (200+ char) filename
uploads a filename with unicode + special characters
uploads a zero-byte file
selecting a second file replaces the first before submit
e2e/file-upload.spec.ts
File upload
uploads a text file successfully
uploads a PDF file successfully
uploads a large (~5MB) binary file successfully
exposes the uploaded filename verbatim in the success response
site bug: submit with no file shows success with empty filename
e2e/healing-demo.spec.ts
Self-healing demonstration
heals a deliberately broken submit-button selector
e2e/security-smoke.spec.ts
Security — smoke checks
XSS payload in email field is treated as plain text
SQL-style injection in password field returns the same generic error
login form does not reflect the typed email back into the DOM as HTML
e2e/session-edge-cases.spec.ts
Session — edge cases
refresh on shop page returns to login (in-memory session, no persistence)
direct navigation to /auth_ecommerce while logged out lands on login form
two-tab login: a fresh tab does not inherit the first tab's session
network/error-handling.spec.ts
Network — error handling
app survives a 500 from an intercepted asset request
slow network: login still completes when responses are throttled
offline mid-flow: action after going offline does not corrupt UI state
